title: Slovakian Roasted Pork
description: A twist on traditional roasted pork, inspired by Slovakian flavors and Chinese technique.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, five-spice powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork shoulder in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the pork for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
While the pork is cooking, combine roasted red peppers, soy sauce, and rice vinegar in a blender or food processor.
Puree the mixture until smooth and set aside.
After the pork has been roasting for 30 minutes, brush the pureed pepper mixture all over it.
Continue roasting the pork for another 20-30 minutes, or until it's nicely browned and caramelized.
Let the pork rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
